topics.label: Introduction and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics provide the opening framing, outlining the lecture aims, historical context, and expected learning outcomes.

topics.label: Tumour virology and the discovery of cellular oncogenes
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how the study of transforming viruses and experimental transformation assays led to the identification of cellular proto-oncogenes.

topics.label: Classification and genetics of oncogenes and tumour suppressors
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the functional definitions and genetic mechanisms distinguishing oncogenes from tumour suppressor genes, including allele dosage and dominant negative effects.

topics.label: Mechanisms and cellular consequences of genetic instability
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore the pathways and cellular defects generating sequence and chromosomal instability, along with their downstream impacts on cancer cells.

topics.label: Multistep tumorigenesis and hereditary cancer predispositions
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore how cumulative genetic alterations and inherited germline mutations accelerate tumor development and drive cancer progression.

topics.label: Conclusion and further reading
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics provide the closing framing, summarizing the lecture, suggesting supplementary reading, and previewing the next session.
